data_description_zh:
1. 原則上一次就醫（同一醫院同一天同一科別一筆資料）一筆資料。
2. 內容包含病人當次就醫之疾病、醫院及費用等相關資料。
notes_zh:
1. 計算人次時，補報資料不應重覆計算。
2. 計算費用時，補報資料應合併。
3. 本手冊所列之檔案格式及資料描述係參考「全民健康保險醫事服務機構(門診、住
院及交付機構)醫療費用點數申報格式及填表說明」，路徑：衛生福利部中央健康
保險署首頁∕醫事機構∕醫療費用支付∕醫療費用申報規定∕醫療費用 XML 申
報格式∕全民健康保險醫事服務機構(門診、住院及交付機構)醫療費用點數申報
格式及填表說明。
※本中心資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，如有身分
證字號、院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入院日期
等欄位均經屏蔽處理，且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使用，並攜出

entries.label_en: Note: The NHIA describes case classification for Western-medicine outpatient fees as follows: (1) For daily-dose drug-fee billing, the class is '01: Western-medicine general case', but chronic disease may not be billed as a general case. (4) Cases not covered above are '09: Western-medicine other special case'. (5) When acute and chronic disease are treated together, the class is '09'; if a refillable chronic prescription is also issued, report class '04', and fill item 22 'days of medication' with the highest day count among the chronic drugs (revised ROC 93/03). (6) A '01: general case' dispensed via referral should be reported as '09'.

(4) Cases not covered above are '09: Western-medicine other special case'. (5) When acute and chronic disease are treated together, the class is '09'; if a refillable chronic prescription is also issued, report class '04', and fill item 22 'days of medication' with the highest day count among the chronic drugs (revised ROC 93/03). (6) A '01: general case' dispensed via referral should be reported as '09'.

CITY.notes: This is the current (104年以後) 4-digit ROC municipality/township code scheme referenced by NHIRD manuals for hospital/clinic location (CITY), patient household registration location (RESID/RESIDCD), and rare-disease reporting/treating hospital location fields (TRA_CITY/PRA_CITY). Codes 0119/0120 (Taipei Wanhua/Wenshan Districts) appeared visually tripled in the source PDF due to a merged-cell rendering artifact; only one entry each is kept here. Code 4326 is printed in the source as "屏東縣三地鄉" (dropping the middle character of the official name 三地門鄉/Sandimen Township) -- transcribed literally per the source, with the correct official identity noted in label_en. Code 0536 "臺南市中區" appears in the source alongside 0534 "臺南市中西區"; both are transcribed as printed even though modern Tainan City has no separate 中區 administrative district (中區 and 西區 were merged into 中西區 in 1990) -- this looks like a legacy/duplicate code retained in the NHI table.

After the Assisted Reproduction Data Reporting and Management Regulations took effect in ROC year 96 (2007), coding was revised for linkage with other databases; pre-2007 old data was also converted to the new coding, but some codes may produce garbled or unknown values due to format or gaps in the new coding. 4. Further reference: HPA Assisted Reproduction Data Reporting and Management Regulations. Note: This center's databases are de-identified (fields masked as above); data may only be used on-site and only approved aggregate results exported.
primary_keys_en:

3. Key value for personal account and personal information matching: ID.
4. Medical institution account and data matching key value: HOSP_ID.
